hints.title: Level Order Incomplete Node Candidate Retention
hints.text: A complete binary tree fills nodes level by level from left to right; only nodes missing a left or right child can accept a new child.

hints.title: Queue of Candidate Parents
hints.text: Traverse the initial tree using BFS. Retain in a candidate list all nodes that do not yet have two children.

hints.title: CBTInserter Blueprint
hints.text: In init: run BFS, collect incomplete nodes into a deque. In insert(val): create node, attach as left child of deque[0] if left is NULL, else attach as right child and pop deque[0]. Append new node to deque. Return parent value.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

complexity.time: O(N) init, O(1) insert, O(1) get_root
variables: N: number of nodes in tree
complexity.notes: Initial BFS examines all N nodes in O(N); candidate deque allows constant time parent lookup and insertion.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Re-running BFS from the root on every single insert requires O(N) per insertion.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Candidate deque stores up to N/2 leaf and incomplete parent references.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Maintaining active parent queue to achieve true O(1) insertion time.
